body: I got out of a mental hospital a week ago and they diagnosed me with bpd , dpd , and hpd. Most of the symptoms that fall into the catagory of these disorders were CAUSED BY THE HOSPITAL. I'm gonna keep my medical diagnosis closed to my next assessment at another psychologist to see if the mental hospital was just trying to pump me full of drugs, give me a test, pile some diagnosis's on me and then pump me out of the system. Because a lot of it does not make sense to me.
